reasoning: On the season so far the Raptors are the stronger team; with home court the Raptors start about 6 points better, in a game of about 226 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Raptors.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Raptors (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Raptors win 73 times in 100, by about 8; most games like this end between 197 and 245 total points.

analyst.text: Kawhi Leonard (left-knee swelling) is out at least another week, with Dec 1 against Houston the earliest return. Toronto are also without RJ Barrett, and Brooklyn lost rookie Nolan Traore for 8-10 weeks. With both rosters thin, nothing in the news changes the numbers' lean towards Toronto at home.
